title: Figures 69-70: Tic Tac CFD temperature and Mach number at 200 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 69. Tic Tac Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 200 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (warm trailing wake, in K) and "Figure 70. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 200 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (low-speed wake within a faster flow field). Attachment II, page 118 of the BAASS report.
